entries.title: Copy a saved secret's value from Settings
entries.body: A secret's row in Settings, Secrets, now has Copy value. Each press asks your computer to confirm it is you, with Touch ID or your password on a Mac, then puts the value on this computer's clipboard only, never on your other devices. Infinitary clears it 90 seconds later, or when you choose Clear now or quit, unless you have copied something else since. Each copy shows in the secret's history as Copied by you, and Firstmate can open a secret's row for you when you ask to read one back.

picture.alt: A secret's row in Settings, Secrets, saying its value is on the clipboard until a time, with Clear now
